name: measurement-profile
goal: Entity size measurements appear within Performance profile without a separate Size card.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Size and Performance profile currently render separate cards. Group the same measurements in Performance profile across overview and legacy details; preserve values, notes, profiles and responsive layout.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standardized entity overview/details tests require separate Size and Performance regions. Strengthen those tests and visual-overview browser checkpoints to require one Performance profile containing all size rows at current and selected commits across three widths.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed c3dc2368. Frozen red record a46f86b0ae1f66740ef4f9fe660051c90830e4bec1d221051e7c3452c0566eed fails the unchanged size shares performance profile assertion at desktop, tablet and mobile. Before screenshots captured by the same standardized visual-overview test.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
